_about: PADEXTRAS v1 (laneTOP20C). Gamepad actions that had no pad binding, plus right-stick free look. Read by PadExtras.cs (NEW). Missing file or enabled=false = the old behaviour bit for bit. rows[]: action = press:<move id> | feint | potionCycle | recenter; trigger = button (KeyCode name, JoystickButtonN: 0 A, 1 B, 2 X, 3 Y, 4 LB, 5 RB, 6 Back, 7 Start, 8 L3, 9 R3) OR axis + axisSign (Input Manager axis name, edge when |value| >= axisThreshold in that sign; the D-pad is the axis DPadY: up = +1 on Windows XInput, flip axisSign if a pad reports it the other way); chord = buttons that must be held (the row with the most chord buttons wins for the same trigger). look: the right stick turns the free camera (never while locked on, never while a blockWhileHeld button is held); deg/s at full deflection, radial dead zone, response curve. Run is the controls.json run row (pad JoystickButton8 = L3, hold). The stance switch stays on D-pad left/right (stances.json padAxisX = DPadX).

rows.note: LB + D-pad up (wins over kick while LB is held)
LB + D-pad down (wins over feint while LB is held)
